phases.name: Community nominations
phases.title: Your timeline can start the next meme.
phases.description: Build the launch foundation, then turn your @rugless nominations into eligible memes. Include a token name, ticker, image idea and thesis. The core fee engine, release checks and community controls belong to this same foundation.

features.name: Prove the initial allocation is burned
features.benefit: Check the create, buy and full-burn transaction before the launch system expands.
features.acceptance: Devnet proof: finalized atomic create + initial buy + full burn; zero tokens remain in the initial buyer account; mint and freeze authorities checked. This is not a mainnet release.

features.name: Capture @rugless nominations
features.benefit: Collect the original post and your suggested name, ticker, image and thesis so the community can understand the full pitch.
features.acceptance: Capture the original post, author, nominator, suggested token name, ticker, image description or reference, thesis and timestamp. Combine reply threads into one nomination. Ask why this meme, why now, who would rally around it and what evidence supports it. Suggestions do not reserve names or tickers. Cover retries and consent-aware retention.

features.name: One meme, one nomination record
features.benefit: Bring duplicate tags together so every eligible nominator can be counted fairly.
features.acceptance: Canonical post IDs, repeated tags and duplicate narratives are reconciled.

features.name: Keep manufactured hype out
features.benefit: Check eligibility and suspicious activity before your nomination can become a launch.
features.acceptance: Published eligibility rules, spam detection and rejection reasons are reviewable.

features.name: Launch within published limits
features.benefit: Let eligible ideas launch only when funding and execution checks pass.
features.acceptance: Launch-pool budget, signer limits, simulation and recovery checks pass on staging.

features.name: Discover launches and inspect the receipts
features.benefit: Read the AI’s recorded launch thesis, supporting evidence, community devs and burn receipts. Copy the CA and open Pump.fun when you want to trade.
features.acceptance: Publish the contemporaneous AI decision summary, reasons, source evidence, uncertainties and decision record. Do not retrospectively invent an AI rationale. Token pages show the launch thesis first, community discussion and dev credits, copyable CA and an external Pump.fun link. No embedded trading or chart. Current AI examples are illustrative; verified mainnet discovery and real AI decision records remain pending.

features.name: Reply with the outcome
features.benefit: Know whether your nomination launched, was already known or needs more evidence.
features.acceptance: Deduplicated X replies link to the correct public token page without promising a launch.

features.name: Fund launches and community support transparently
features.benefit: See how creator fees fund new memes and support existing communities, with every allocation accounted for.
features.acceptance: Capture and reconcile $RUGLESS creator fees in SOL: 75% to the Community Pool and 25% to team and operations. Split the Community Pool equally between new launches and existing-token buybacks: each receives 37.5% of total creator fees. Verify separate budget accounting, collection and recovery. Percentages apply to captured creator revenue, not trading volume.

features.name: Buy back and burn $RUGLESS
features.benefit: Let community meme activity feed purchases and permanent burns you can verify.
features.acceptance: Allocate 100% of net meme creator fees to $RUGLESS purchases; burn every acquired token. Verify costs, execution, receipts and recovery. No direct SOL payouts. The separate Phase 2 meme-support budget must not silently divert this commitment.

features.name: Pass the mainnet release checks
features.benefit: Bring the complete financial path to production only after the evidence holds up.
features.acceptance: Complete security and production integration reviews; reconcile fee flows; test signer controls, monitoring and recovery drills; publish incident procedures and pass the 72-hour community release gate.

features.name: Put policy control in community hands
features.benefit: Help determine how the ecosystem evolves as the core system becomes dependable.
features.acceptance: Agree reviewer selection and governance rules, then develop on-chain control of future parameters with timelocks. Publish performance evidence before expanding authority or discovery. This foundation milestone matures across later phases.

features.name: Share and review community theses
features.benefit: Read new perspectives on each coin and add yours by tagging @rugless with its CA or ticker.
features.acceptance: Connect authorized X ingestion; match exact contract addresses and resolve ambiguous tickers; deduplicate; add an approval queue, spam/scam/impersonation checks, reports, appeals and deletion reconciliation. Publish source links and freshness. Allow reasoned counter-theses.

phases.name: Social-first meme buybacks
phases.title: Give active communities another chance.
phases.description: Support Rugless-created meme pairs with real social activity, including low-volume communities that are still showing up. This is a separate proposal from the $RUGLESS buy-and-burn engine.

features.name: Measure people showing up
features.benefit: See activity from distinct participants, ongoing conversations and original posts.
features.acceptance: Publish signal definitions and observation windows; raw tweet counts alone cannot decide support.

features.name: Put social activity before volume
features.benefit: Keep active, low-volume pairs eligible instead of rewarding trading size alone.
features.acceptance: Publish weights and test that a socially active low-volume pair can outrank a high-volume pair with weak social activity.

features.name: Filter bots and wash trading
features.benefit: Make coordinated fake activity less useful in the selection process.
features.acceptance: Sybil signals, bot activity, wash-volume checks and an appeal path are reviewed.

features.name: Reserve half the pool for existing memes
features.benefit: Your community can receive buyback support for strong activity or a chart in need of support, without taking the new-launch budget.
features.acceptance: Allocate 50% of the 75% Community Pool to existing-token buybacks, equal to 37.5% of total $RUGLESS creator fees. Rank top community activity and chart-support needs, weighting social activity above volume. Publish selection reasons and budget receipts. Preserve the other half for launches and the separate 100% net meme-fee commitment to $RUGLESS buybacks and burns.

features.name: Buy with clear limits
features.benefit: Support selected pairs with liquidity-aware execution and visible safeguards.
features.acceptance: Per-pair caps, slippage limits, simulation, circuit breakers and treasury reconciliation pass staging.

features.name: Show every decision and purchase
features.benefit: Understand which communities received support and what was spent.
features.acceptance: Publish eligibility reasons, transactions and outcomes; define whether purchased meme tokens are held, vested or burned before launch.

phases.name: Rewards for nominators
phases.title: Get credit for finding the idea early.
phases.description: If your nominated post becomes a meme, eligible people who tagged it share a small, defined portion of the initial developer purchase, vested over seven days.

features.name: Agree the reward pool and burn split
features.benefit: Know what nominators share and what will still be burned.
features.acceptance: Set a capped total reward percentage and allocation formula. This explicitly changes the current full-burn rule and requires community review.

features.name: Snapshot eligible nominations
features.benefit: Keep the reward tied to real nominations made before the cutoff.
features.acceptance: Publish cutoff, unique-account rules, deduplication, anti-Sybil checks and treatment of deleted or private posts.

features.name: Prove X account control privately
features.benefit: Link your eligibility to a wallet without publishing a direct X-to-wallet directory.
features.acceptance: Design the identity flow and threat model; disclose what X, the operator and infrastructure can observe. ZK design remains research.

features.name: Build private eligibility proofs
features.benefit: Prove you qualify without exposing your X identity in the claim.
features.acceptance: Evaluate ZK proofs, a credential issuer, replay prevention and nullifiers; test metadata leakage and cross-claim linkability.

features.name: Vest rewards over seven days
features.benefit: Claim only the rewards unlocked under the published schedule.
features.acceptance: Contract specifies vesting start and release curve, prevents duplicate claims and passes independent review and adversarial tests.

features.name: Ship the wallet and claim experience
features.benefit: See your allocation, unlock schedule and claim receipt in one place.
features.acceptance: Wallet linking, proof creation, failed claims and recovery pass staging; privacy claims match audited guarantees, not an anonymity promise.

phases.name: Autonomous discovery
phases.title: Catch the moment before you have to tag it.
phases.description: Rugless researches X and other social platforms to find emerging topics and propose or create memes within community-approved rules.

features.name: Add permitted social sources
features.benefit: Bring useful signals together without relying on a single feed.
features.acceptance: Confirm platform access, permitted use, retention and source attribution for every integration.

features.name: Spot trends across communities
features.benefit: Surface emerging narratives instead of repeating the same idea.
features.acceptance: Measure momentum, cross-source evidence and narrative deduplication with an inspectable evaluation set.

features.name: Check whether an idea should launch
features.benefit: Apply the same evidence and eligibility standards to autonomous ideas.
features.acceptance: Review manipulation, impersonation, rights and sensitive-content rules with explicit rejection paths.

features.name: Run in observation mode first
features.benefit: See what the system would create before it can spend funds.
features.acceptance: Publish shadow-run decisions and errors; compare against community nominations before expanding authority.

features.name: Enable bounded autonomous launches
features.benefit: Let qualifying trends launch within a budget you can inspect.
features.acceptance: Community approves launch frequency, spending caps, signing limits and a pause mechanism; each launch includes its source trail.

phases.name: Community takeovers
phases.title: Find communities worth rebuilding with.
phases.description: Combine on-chain evidence with community activity and @rugless tags to identify potentially eligible rug-pulled tokens for a CTO. Eligibility is not a promise of recovery.

features.name: Receive community rescue nominations
features.benefit: Give affected holders a clear way to ask for an assessment.
features.acceptance: Capture the mint, incident evidence and distinct community nominations from X without treating tags as proof.

features.name: Investigate the on-chain incident
features.benefit: See the evidence behind a suspected rug before any action is proposed.
features.acceptance: Inspect authorities, holder concentration, liquidity changes and transaction history; distinguish evidence from unverified allegations.

features.name: Check whether the community is still there
features.benefit: Prioritize real people who want to rebuild.
features.acceptance: Assess sustained social participation and ownership concentration with bot and Sybil resistance.

features.name: Publish takeover eligibility rules
features.benefit: Know why a token qualifies, needs more evidence or is rejected.
features.acceptance: Require removable control risks, a viable liquidity plan, community consent and a disclosed risk assessment.

features.name: Put each rescue plan to review
features.benefit: Let the community inspect the budget and control changes before execution.
features.acceptance: Publish a token-specific proposal with custody, migration, liquidity, limits and exit conditions; apply the core 72-hour review gate.

features.name: Pilot and report the outcome
features.benefit: Follow what a takeover actually changed, including its limits.
features.acceptance: Run constrained pilots with public transactions and monitoring. Do not promise restored prices, recovered losses or future safety.
